Made both changes:

  • More space — traffic cars now enforce a minimum gap in each lane before a new one spawns, and they appear less frequently overall, so you've got real room to react and switch lanes
  • New car design — smoother curved aerodynamic body (bezier-curve shaped, not just a rounded box), a proper windshield with a tinted panel, a center racing stripe running front-to-back, side mirrors, and cleaner wheel wells for a sleeker sports-car silhouette

Claude responded: Here's your game as three separate files — HTML, CSS, and JS — ready to download and run anywhere (just open index.

Created 3 files, ran a command, read a file

Here's your game as three separate files — HTML, CSS, and JS — ready to download and run anywhere (just open index.html in a browser, keeping all three files in the same folder):

  • index.html — page structure and layout
  • style.css — all styling, with separate responsive rules for mobile (larger touch buttons, swipe-friendly) and PC (mouse-sized controls)
  • script.js — full game logic

What's new:

  • Red sports car for your player car (blue/other colors kept for traffic)
  • Sound on/off button in the top bar — toggles all beeps and effects
  • Mobile support — swipe left/right directly on the canvas to steer, plus larger tap-friendly buttons
  • PC support — arrow keys still work, buttons resize slightly smaller for mouse use
  • Same fuel/coin system, levels, and best-scores table as before

Just download the three files into one folder and double-click index.html to play. Want me to also add a title screen, difficulty selector, or save high scores permanently (would need browser storage, which I can add with a note on how it behaves)?

Claude responded: Now let's copy the updated file and give you a live preview too: Added an engine sound — a low, synthesized rumble (two slightly detuned oscillators run throug…

Edited 4 files, ran a command, read a file · 1 note

Added an engine sound — a low, synthesized rumble (two slightly detuned oscillators run through a filter) that runs continuously while you play and gets a bit higher-pitched and brighter as your speed increases with each level. It:

  • Starts the moment you steer or hit restart (browsers require a user interaction before audio can play, so it can't start automatically on load)
  • Fades out cleanly when you crash
  • Respects the sound on/off toggle — mutes instantly and won't restart until you turn sound back on

Just re-download script.js (same folder as before, next to index.html and style.css) and open index.html again. Want me to also add tire-screech sound when you switch lanes quickly, or a horn button for fun?

function rectsOverlap(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
159
return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
160
}
161
function circleRectOverlap(cx, cy, cr, bx, by, bw, bh) {
162
var nx = Math.max(bx - bw / 2, Math.min(cx, bx + bw / 2));
163
var ny = Math.max(by - bh / 2, Math.min(cy, by + bh / 2));
164
var dx = cx - nx, dy = cy - ny;
165
return dx * dx + dy * dy < cr * cr;
166
}
